executiveSummary: Iteration 000008 delivers txt2vid and img2vid inference end-to-end with full compliance after two targeted fixes: gateway validation for width/height/duration, and worker MP4 output verification.
minorObservations: US-005-AC06 browser visual verification is outside static audit scope.
outputs.ts content-type detection is extension-only; future artifact types would need it updated.
video_fps is not surfaced as a user-configurable parameter in the playground or gateway API.
No client-side image size validation in playground before sending base64.
playground.ts is 600+ lines; consider modularising in a future iteration.

fixes.description: Added validation for txt2vid/img2vid jobs that rejects non-positive width/height (must be positive integers) and non-positive duration (must be positive number) with 400 and a descriptive error.
Added post-save_video() check in both img2vid and txt2vid branches that verifies the output file exists and has .mp4 suffix; raises RuntimeError otherwise, propagating as a failed job.

conclusionsAndRecommendations: Both compliance gaps resolved. All FRs and USs now comply. Minor observations are low-priority and tracked for future iterations.
